name: homestead-electric
//: jsdom gives scripts/sanitize-test.js a DOM under plain node. It was previously resolving only as a transitive dep of react-scripts — so a react-scripts change would have broken `prebuild`, and therefore every build and every push, with a confusing error. Declared explicitly at the version already on disk. NOTE: this note lives at the TOP LEVEL on purpose — npm's `//` comment convention only works here. Inside `dependencies`/`devDependencies` every key is parsed as a package NAME, so a `//` entry there fails `npm install` with EINVALIDPACKAGENAME and takes every Vercel deploy down with it (2026-08-05).

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/version-from-sw.js && node scripts/gcportal-test.js && node scripts/gcnotify-test.js && node scripts/sanitize-test.js && node scripts/pending-queue-test.js
